title: 十三章 天门
content_zh:
翌日晌午，经过白虎接近一天不知疲惫的疾驰，终于驮着许元来到了目的地。
放走白虎后，许元独自站在侧峰之巅，前方便是深达万丈的悬天之崖。
踏前一步，许元试着向着悬天崖下看了一眼。
目光所及之处，尽是一片被云雾包裹的无尽深渊。
忽地，山巅之上云雾一阵翻腾，一股劲风忽然袭来，吹得许元周身的锦绣华袍一阵咧咧作响，身形也是忽地一阵摇晃。
见状，许元慢慢退回到了悬天崖的封顶内部。
在《沧源》的游戏中，他可以毫不犹豫的控制角色往这悬天崖下跳，但如今还是算了。
收回目光，许元朝着天门山的主峰望去。
由此望彼，远隔千丈。
在那主峰巍峨壁仞之外，仙雾缭绕，由下及上，云雾恍然破空，庞然的山体上一道数百丈的巨大圆形豁口宛若通天之门！
看着那巨大的通天之门，不知为何，许元除了震撼，心中莫名的感受到了一股不适。
直到将远眺的目光挪开，这种不适感才缓缓消散。
好奇之下，许元再次朝着那天门望去。
很快，方才消散的那股不适又渐渐的开始爬上心头。
“这是什么？为什么盯着那处天门会有这种感觉？”
许元察觉身体异样，忙不迭的收回视线，心中有些惊异之下，脑海中闪过了这天门山在公式书中的描述。
下意识抬眸再次望去，许元表情带着一丝将信将疑的愕然：
“这是剑意？这山巅的天门难不成真是被人一剑洞穿的？”
许元忽然觉得自己对于沧源这方世界的了解还是有些少了，局限于游戏《沧源》那2.5D像素风的表现力，这方世界顶级强者究竟能强到何种地步在他根本没有概念。
相比于正统的修仙，在许元认知中这方世界应该更贴合于仙侠。

这里有宗门，有武林，也有庙堂。
难不成这方世界真有人能一剑光寒十九州？
但如果真有人能这么强，那大炎朝堂之上那位与原身老爹势不两立的北方军神不就成了笑话么？
用兵再怎么如何入神，始终抵不过绝强者随手挥出的一剑，这种军神又有何威严？
这世上曾有人一剑洞穿数百丈山峦的震撼，让许元的思绪在瞬间想到了很多东西。
愣神间，周围云雾飞速翻滚奔腾。
等到许元回神，恍然察觉自己鼻尖已是湿漉漉的一片。
抬手一擦，掌间的嫣红让他意识自己居然因为直视那座天门而流鼻血了。
忙不迭的转过身，再不去看，而这一转头，正好让许元看到了那东方逐渐升起的鱼肚白。
云雾消散，山巅之上的日出很美，十万大山接尽收眼底，茫然林海被染得血红一片。
许元心神一愣。
因为服用焱灵液的缘故，他并没有感受到饥饿，但长时间站立带来的酸痛却一点点在身体内复苏。
什么情况？
方才他愣神不过片刻，怎么忽然便从晌午到了黎明时分？
这是第二天？
还是说过了不止一天？
超出理解的事情降临在自己身上，许元想要试图找寻出原因，但很快他便意识到现在不是思考这个的时候。
时间既然过了这么久，那大冰坨子人呢？
那白虎都只需要大半天时间便从山腰登顶这里，现在时间至少过了一天半，冉青墨她居然还没到？
思索间，许元的心一点点的沉了下来

出现如今这种局面的最好的情况便是冉青墨为了保证安全，主动引走了对方暂时还没能摆脱。
而最糟的......
冉青墨的实力是毋庸置疑的，但在这个剧情点，这世上比她强的人依旧大有人在。
许元连忙止住思绪，不让自己胡思乱想。
他对现在自己所处的境遇非常清楚。
如果冉青墨死在了路上，除非他能用高达3点的福缘赌命从这悬天崖上跳下去，成功进入那处洞府，不然他也可以直接宣告死亡。
呆在这悬天崖旁，不管先找上门来的人是那想杀他的，还是原身老爹的手下，他都必死无疑。
“斥异症”的出现直接把许元很多倚仗的退路都给封死。
他穿越而来鸠占鹊巢的手段并不是高于这方世界规则的完美魂穿，而是在这方世界规则之下的夺舍重生。
虽然夺舍重生除了一开始会有一段时间会衍生 “斥异症”外，其余便相较完美，但万事皆有阴阳。
夺舍在这方世界里存在了如此之久，自然会衍生出一些检测手段。
虽然这种检测手段已经近乎失传，但却确确实实存在。
而最要命的，这检测手段原身老爹手下有人就会用。
虽然没有人会平白无故的来怀疑他，但他许元终究不是许长天，在真正亲近之人面前，估计不需片刻便会察觉异样。
异样被发觉，一系列检测套餐下来，许元都不敢想自己的下场会是什么样。
使肉身与意魂完美融合的方法确实是有，但那些东西在这悬天崖下方的那处洞府里。
一旦那大冰坨子死了，他许元根本没有机会下去拿。
深深吸了一口气，许元强制让自己止住了思绪，控制着略显酸疼的身体，盘坐到了地上。
他想再多也都是没用的，现在他能做的便只是安心等待结果。
而刚一坐下不久，许元却隐隐感觉地面似乎在发生颤动。

立刻垂眸向下望去，但目光所及只能见到一些细碎的石子安静的躺在地面。
许元不认为是自己感受错了，目不转睛的注视着这些细碎石子。
而在大约十几秒后，眼前的一片细石果然再次开始了颤动。
而且这一次颤动比上次的若隐若现要强烈了数倍，甚至伴随着一阵声波扩散开去席卷过山巅的巨树森林。
又过了十秒后，
“轰——”
身下震感更加的明显，整个山崖都似乎在隐隐摇晃。
是地震？
还是说......
许元眼中闪过一丝惊疑不定，抬眸朝着来时的路望去。
一眼仿若万年
在那不断东升的耀眼旭日之间，许元隐约看到了看到了一个黑点，而这黑点正在视野间快速放大，直接一道巨大黑影覆盖了天际那轮旭日，朝着他极速飞来。
“轰——”
巨大的黑影，如天外陨石重重砸在了许元面前十余米外的空地上，强大的冲击使山巅之上瞬间飞沙走石，烟尘四起。
等到烟尘散去，
一颗十余米高的巨蟒头颅已然出现在许元的面前。
而在那片金黄的黎明之中，
那颗狰狞的蛇头之上，一道清丽的黑色倩影持剑而立，身后的三千如瀑青丝随风轻轻飘扬........
content_en:
At noon the next day, after nearly a day of tireless galloping, the white tiger finally arrived at its destination carrying Xu Yuan.
After letting the white tiger go, Xu Yuan stood alone on the top of the side peak, with the cliff in front of him that was as deep as 10,000 feet.
Taking a step forward, Xu Yuan tried to take a look at the cliff.
Everywhere he looked, there was an endless abyss wrapped in clouds and mist.
Suddenly, the clouds and mist on the top of the mountain rolled, and a strong wind suddenly hit, making Xu Yuan's embroidered robes ruffle and his figure suddenly sway.
Seeing this, Xu Yuan slowly retreated to the top of Xantian Cliff.
In the game "Cangyuan", he could control the character to jump off this cliff without hesitation, but now he had to forget about it.
Withdrawing his gaze, Xu Yuan looked towards the main peak of Tianmen Mountain.
Looking from here to the other side, they are thousands of feet away.
Outside the majestic wall of the main peak, fairy mist was lingering. From bottom to top, the clouds and mist suddenly broke through the sky. A huge circular gap hundreds of feet in the huge mountain was like a door to the sky!
Looking at the huge door to the sky, for some reason, Xu Yuan was not only shocked, but also felt an inexplicable discomfort in his heart.
It wasn't until I moved my gaze away that the discomfort slowly dissipated.
Out of curiosity, Xu Yuan looked towards Tiantianmen again.
Soon, the discomfort that had just dissipated gradually began to creep into my heart.
"What is this? Why do you feel this way when you stare at that heavenly gate?"
Xu Yuan noticed something strange about his body and hurriedly looked away. With some surprise in his heart, the description of Tianmen Mountain in the formula book flashed through his mind.
Subconsciously raising his eyes and looking again, Xu Yuan's expression showed a trace of doubtful astonishment:
"Is this the intention of the sword? Could it be that the Tianmen on the top of the mountain was really penetrated by a sword?"
Xu Yuan suddenly felt that his understanding of the world of Cangyuan was still somewhat limited. Limited to the expressive power of the 2.5D pixel style of the game "Cangyuan", he had no idea how strong the world's top powerhouses could be.
Compared with the orthodox cultivation of immortals, in Xu Yuan's perception, this world should be more suitable for immortals.
There are sects, martial arts forests, and temples here.
Is it possible that there is really someone in this world who can wipe out nineteen states with one sword?
But if someone can really be so strong, then wouldn’t the Northern Military God who is at odds with his original father at the Great Yan Court become a joke?
No matter how enchanted he is in using soldiers, he will never be able to withstand a sword swung by an extremely strong man. What majesty does this kind of military god have?
In this world, the shock of someone piercing through hundreds of feet of mountains with a sword made Xu Yuan's mind think of many things in an instant.
In a daze, the surrounding clouds and mist rolled rapidly.
When Xu Yuan came to his senses, he suddenly realized that the tip of his nose was already wet.
He raised his hand to wipe it, and the bright red color in his palm made him realize that he actually had a nosebleed because he looked directly at the heavenly gate.
He turned around hurriedly and stopped looking. This turn of his head happened to allow Xu Yuan to see the white fish belly rising gradually in the east.
The clouds and mist dissipated, and the sunrise on the top of the mountain was beautiful. Hundreds of thousands of mountains were all in sight, and the vast forest sea was dyed blood red.
Xu Yuan was stunned.
Because he took Yanling Liquid, he didn't feel hungry, but the pain caused by standing for a long time revived in his body bit by bit.
What's going on?
He had been stunned for only a moment, why did it suddenly change from noon to dawn?
Is this the second day?
Or did you say it for more than one day?
Something beyond his understanding happened to him. Xu Yuan wanted to try to find out the reason, but he soon realized that now was not the time to think about it.
Since so much time has passed, where is the big Bingtuo people?
It only took the White Tiger most of a day to climb to the top from the mountainside. Now it has been at least a day and a half, and Ran Qingmo hasn't arrived yet?
While thinking, Xu Yuan's heart sank a little bit.
The best situation for the current situation is that in order to ensure safety, Ran Qingmo, took the initiative to lure the other party away and was unable to get rid of it for the time being.
And the worst...
There is no doubt about Ran Qingmo's strength, but at this plot point, there are still many people in the world who are stronger than her.
Xu Yuan quickly stopped his thoughts and stopped himself from thinking wildly.
He is very clear about the situation he is in now.
If Ran Qingmo dies on the road, unless he can use up to 3 points of luck to jump off the cliff and successfully enter the cave, he can also declare death directly.
Staying next to this cliff, no matter whether the person who comes to the door first is the one who wants to kill him, or he is one of his original father's men, he will definitely die.
The emergence of "exotic repulsion syndrome" directly blocked many of Xu Yuan's escape routes.
His method of traveling through time and occupying the magpie's nest was not a perfect soul penetration that was higher than the rules of this world, but a rebirth under the rules of this world.
Although rebirth is relatively perfect except for the "rejection syndrome" that will occur for a period of time at the beginning, there is a yin and yang in everything.
Seizing the body has existed in this world for so long, so some detection methods will naturally be derived.
Although this detection method has been almost lost, it does exist.
And the most terrible thing is that someone under the original father knows how to use this detection method.
Although no one would doubt him for no reason, he, Xu Yuan, was not Xu Changtian after all. In front of someone who was really close to him, it probably wouldn't take a moment to notice something strange.
The same thing was discovered, and after a series of testing packages, Xu Yuan didn't dare to think about what his end would be.
There are indeed ways to perfectly integrate the physical body with the mind and soul, but those things are in the cave under the cliff.
Once the big ice lump dies, Xu Yuan will have no chance to get it.
Taking a deep breath, Xu Yuan forced himself to stop his thoughts, controlled his slightly sore body, and sat cross-legged on the ground.
No matter how much he thinks about it, it's useless. All he can do now is wait for the result with peace of mind.
But not long after he sat down, Xu Yuan faintly felt that the ground seemed to be shaking.
He immediately lowered his eyes and looked down, but as far as he could see, he could only see some fine stones lying quietly on the ground.
Xu Yuan didn't think that his feelings were wrong, and stared at the tiny pebbles intently.
And after about ten seconds, a piece of fine stone in front of him really started to tremble again.
And this time the tremor was several times stronger than the last time, and it was even accompanied by a sound wave that spread out and swept through the forest of giant trees on the top of the mountain.
After another ten seconds,
"Boom——"
The earthquake felt more obvious underneath me, and the entire cliff seemed to be shaking faintly.
Is it an earthquake?
Or should I say...
A trace of surprise and uncertainty flashed in Xu Yuan's eyes, and he raised his eyes and looked towards the way he came.
One glance seems like ten thousand years
Between the dazzling sun that continued to rise in the east, Xu Yuan vaguely saw a black spot, and the black spot was rapidly enlarging in his field of vision, and a huge black shadow covered the rising sun in the sky and flew towards him at high speed.
"Boom——"
A huge black shadow, like a meteorite from the sky, hit the open space more than ten meters away in front of Xu Yuan. The powerful impact caused sand and rocks to fly and smoke to fly on the top of the mountain.
Wait until the smoke clears,
A giant python head more than ten meters high has appeared in front of Xu Yuan.
And in that golden dawn,
On top of the ferocious snake head, a beautiful black silhouette stands with a sword, and three thousand waterfalls of green silk behind it are gently fluttering in the wind...
